definitions.gloss: major house cleaning; thorough cleaning; spring cleaning
definitions.explanation: a comprehensive cleaning of an entire home or space, often done at year-end in Japan

examples.japanese: {年末|ねんまつ}に{大掃除|おおそうじ}をする。
examples.english: I do major cleaning at the end of the year.

examples.japanese: {大掃除|おおそうじ}で{普段|ふだん}{掃除|そうじ}しない{場所|ばしょ}もきれいにした。
examples.english: During the major cleaning, I also cleaned places I don't usually clean.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}{全員|ぜんいん}で{大掃除|おおそうじ}をして、{新年|しんねん}を{迎|むか}える{準備|じゅんび}をした。
examples.english: The whole family did major cleaning to prepare to welcome the new year.

notes:
FORMATION:
{大|おお} (big, major) + {掃除|そうじ} (cleaning) → big cleaning

VERB FORM:
{大掃除|おおそうじ}する (to do major cleaning)
{大掃除|おおそうじ}をする (to do major cleaning)

YEAR-END TRADITION:
In Japan, {大掃除|おおそうじ} is traditionally done before New Year's ({正月|しょうがつ}) to:
- Cleanse the house of the old year's dust
- Welcome the New Year god ({年神様|としがみさま})
- Start the new year fresh and clean

COMMON TASKS:
- {窓拭|まどふ}き (window cleaning)
- {換気扇|かんきせん}の{掃除|そうじ} (ventilation fan cleaning)
- エアコン{掃除|そうじ} (air conditioner cleaning)
- {押|お}し{入|い}れの{整理|せいり} (closet organization)

RELATED TERMS:
- {断捨離|だんしゃり} (decluttering)
- {整理整頓|せいりせいとん} (organizing and tidying)
